Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

phone — a telephone. Example: I have got a new phone.
computer — a machine for storing and using data. Example: We use the computer at home.
problem — something that is wrong. Example: My computer has got a problem.
close — to shut an app or a window. Example: Close the app when you finish.
open — to start an app or a file. Example: Open the app.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My computer doesn't work.
• Close the app and open it again.
• Don't share your password.
• You should restart it.
• It works now.
